title: build with no subcommand, or an unknown one, exits 2 with the build usage on stderr; build --help prints it and exits 0
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D6 and the command-group row (jitso build <subcommand>); replaces the oracle's `presets` alone answer, which is the 'not implemented yet' line with exit 0 (TS-ODDITIES C1)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-10, build vocabulary; docs/decisions.md D6). The catalog commands live under one command group, `jitso build <subcommand>`. With no subcommand it exits 2 and prints `jitso build: missing subcommand`, a blank line and the build usage on stderr; with a subcommand it does not know it prints `jitso build: unknown subcommand "<x>"` and the same usage; `--help` and `-h` print the usage on stdout and exit 0. The oracle has no `build` command at all (its catalog command is `presets`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2, so the `missing subcommand` and `unknown subcommand` expectations and the `--help` exit code FAIL on TS.
